capabilities.title: Multi-agent framework: separate analyst, risk, and execution agents with defined handoff contracts
capabilities.sourceEvidence: TradingAgents: specialized agents for technical analysis, fundamentals, sentiment, and risk management
capabilities.reason: Nexus ALPHA has TradeThesisPanel with single-agent analysis; multi-agent decomposition (analyst/risk/execution roles) not yet implemented.

capabilities.title: Fundamental analysis agent: earnings, revenue growth, P/E, sector context
capabilities.sourceEvidence: TradingAgents fundamentals agent persona and tool set
capabilities.reason: Nexus ALPHA computes basic metrics; a dedicated fundamentals agent with structured financial statement analysis is pending.

capabilities.title: Technical analysis agent: trend detection, support/resistance, indicator synthesis
capabilities.reason: Nexus ALPHA surfaces price data; structured technical analysis agent producing a trade signal with evidence is pending.

capabilities.title: Sentiment analysis agent: news, social media, and options flow sentiment scoring
capabilities.reason: Nexus INTEL has Fear & Greed index; dedicated sentiment agent ingesting news and social signals is pending.

capabilities.title: Risk management agent: position sizing, drawdown limits, stop-loss recommendations
capabilities.sourceEvidence: TradingAgents risk agent with portfolio-level checks
capabilities.reason: Nexus ALPHA has thesis panels but no risk management agent enforcing drawdown or position sizing rules.

capabilities.title: Agent debate: bullish and bearish agents argue thesis before final recommendation
capabilities.sourceEvidence: TradingAgents debate mode: agents challenge each other's reasoning
capabilities.reason: Nexus produces single-model analysis; adversarial bull/bear debate not implemented.

capabilities.title: Backtesting loop: evaluate agent recommendations against historical price data
capabilities.reason: Nexus ALPHA has no backtesting capability; historical evaluation of agent-generated signals is pending.

capabilities.title: Live order execution via broker API
capabilities.reason: Nexus is an intelligence dashboard, not a trading execution system. Live order routing is out of scope.
